authorityClaim: v2 lands CLAUDE-FCJOIN-V1-SF1. This artifact NAMES the thirteen actor-join fixture classes already named in doctor-actor-leftover-join.v2 / actor-join v8. It does not author those fixtures. It does not force a ride onto G09 or any other live row whose claim does not own actor-join fixture execution. It does not add a DR-G* row. It does not invent a gate. It does not record FC-C1. It does not execute join fixtures. It does not close OBL-JOIN-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114 or DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-JOIN-FX-AUTHORING by naming the thirteen already-named classes without authoring their bytes and without inventing a gate. D-164 recorded that no live DR-G* claim owns actor-join fixture execution. This catalog does not change that standing. v2 is a surgical fold of CLAUDE-FCJOIN-V1-SF1: each named class carries its actor-join v8 definition verbatim.
